description.value:
Frequency at will

Type sustained

Hold still and keep a Marked quarry in view for a full round; your next Strike against it before the end of your following turn ignores lesser and standard cover entirely (greater cover still applies) and deals an extra 1d8 precision damage (2d8 at Blooded, 3d8 at Veteran, 4d8 at Undying).

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'). This card's real blocker is independent: "held still and watched for a full round" isn't a trackable state -- no roll option accumulates "turns spent not moving while watching a specific target." Also unbuilt regardless: the tiered escalation (2d8 at Blooded, 3d8 at Veteran, 4d8 at Undying) -- those tier names are undefined anywhere in the corpus (see waywarden.vanish-between-blinks.json's note).
